title: French Sausage and Kabanos Stir-Fry
description: A quick and flavorful French-inspired stir-fry with sausage and kabanos, perfect for a weeknight dinner.

ingredients.name: nutty
ingredients.notes: Assumed to be a vegetable, e.g. broccoli

ingredients.name: silky
ingredients.notes: Assumed to be a vegetable, e.g. bell pepper

ingredients.name: stir
ingredients.notes: Assumed to be a cooking oil, e.g. vegetable oil

ingredients.name: fry
ingredients.notes: Assumed to be a cooking oil, e.g. vegetable oil

instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced sausage and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the sliced kabanos and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Add the broccoli and bell pepper to the skillet and cook until tender, about 4-5 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the sausage and kabanos mixture over the vegetables and enjoy!
